observed: Ten sequential SRAM-only hardware runs passed with FCB=0x000f0002 and every read0, foreign_read, preservation, phase_pair, half, low, high, rejected_write, overwrite and reset counter zero over 64 patterns each. The sequence was ungated base before; constant-one; constant-zero; !HADDR2; !HADDR3; four independent real !HADDR2&&!HADDR3 runs; ungated base after. Every run ended with board reset and no flash write.
causal_controls: The ungated base passed mask 0xf before and after, proving liveness and unchanged alias behavior; the same base under decoded mask 0x1 failed exactly with foreign_read=2298 and phase_pair=576. Constant-one proved all sixteen state-to-gate-to-MCU paths and the HWDATA9/HRESP local exchange preserve behavior. Constant-zero proved suppression. !HADDR2 and !HADDR3 separately proved both address inputs and their ordering. The real decoder passed four times with [offset +0,+4,+8,+c] = [state,0,0,0].
implementation: One X14Y12_SLICE5 decoder computes !HADDR2&&!HADDR3 and fans out through 37 exact clean edges to sixteen combinational 0x8888 output gates, one per retained HRDATA[15:0] lane. The composer preserves all sixteen original capture-to-feedback paths exactly and removes only each state net's MCU-sink suffix. A bounded three-route local exchange relocates HWDATA9, the HRESP/GND prefix and lane 0's gated output; original roots/leaves and all MCU sinks are preserved. Independent structural audit found zero new cross-net wire owners. Strict pack reports 555 data pips, 536 mapped, 432 block-clean, 30 relative-clean and zero legacy-absolute, predicted or unmapped selectors.
scope: Qualifies one exact L48 16-bit held-scratch composition for low-16 aligned 32-bit word reads at +0,+4,+8,+c, where +0 returns retained state and +4/+8/+c return zero, while retaining the already-qualified aligned word and halfword +0 writes, independent byte +0/+1 writes, foreign-write rejection, overwrite, one wait and GPIO4.1 synchronous reset. It does not qualify byte-read lane semantics, halfword-read lane semantics, misaligned transfers, HRDATA[31:16], higher address decoding or a full slave window, bursts, arbitrary placement/width, a generic bank generator, or integration with the public ID/counter/W1C bank.
consequence: The exact 16-bit checkpoint now has silicon-qualified word-offset isolation on both writes and low-16 aligned word reads. This remains a pinned checkpoint rather than a general 16-bit AHB register-bank claim.
next_experiment: Integrate the exact checkpoint's decoded read exits and retained write semantics into a source-generated public bank candidate, then qualify subword read-lane semantics separately before widening scope.
